instruction: Can you add Terminal (gnome-terminal) to the favorite applications?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Terminal to favorite apps. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [thunderbird, vim, chrome, terminal]. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts favorite-apps state using gsettings command
Metric correctly compares the set of apps and verifies Terminal is added
Expected value correctly includes all original apps plus org.gnome.Terminal.desktop
Length check ensures exactly 4 apps exist (3 original + 1 new)
Set comparison ensures all expected apps are present including Terminal
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The metric uses set comparison which ignores order - this is acceptable for favorite apps but worth noting
Set comparison means the evaluator verifies presence of all apps but not their order in the favorites bar
